purpose: EXA-66 current official Electron release, security advisory, and compatibility evidence. This evidence does not replace application tests, fresh npm audits, interactive checks, or installed-package verification.

recommendation.rationale: Latest patched stable in the already shipped major; same-major update is sufficient for the reviewed Windows runtime advisories without an unnecessary major migration.

support.policy: Latest three stable majors; only latest minor in each supported line receives fixes; oldest supported line receives security fixes directly.

release.notes: 43.8.3 backports upstream ANGLE, Chromium, PDFium, Skia, and V8 fixes (#55147).

artifacts.name: ffmpeg-v43.8.3-win32-x64.zip
artifacts.disposition: Metadata only; binary not downloaded by this review. Coordinate exact version with EXA-65. No codec or license-compliance conclusion is implied.

compatibility.toolchain_scope: Report stale Node 20 CI/AGENTS guidance separately; no CI/toolchain migration is justified as part of this runtime-only update.
compatibility.native_modules: Preserve Electron-targeted native rebuild and ASAR unpack behavior; native loading must be tested against actual installed runtime ABI. Do not infer loading success from release assets.
compatibility.known_backported_behavior_changes: 43.7.0 changes subframe worker integration, DevTools extension preload delivery, and legacy getUserMedia desktop capture using WebContents source IDs. Verify app screen-thumbnail capture, preload, and lifecycle paths.

advisory_scan.comparison: Compared every official affected range to 43.1.0 and 43.8.3 using npm semver, with commas between comparator terms normalized to spaces. The workflow commit-hash range below is not semver and was inspected separately.

selected_version_remaining_range_matches.disposition: Not applicable to Windows. Official impact is limited to macOS applications shipping Squirrel.Mac auto-updates; official metadata includes an unbounded >=40.0.0-alpha.1 range, while prose names later fixed versions. Do not use this Windows disposition for macOS.

non_semver_dispositions.disposition: Upstream Electron repository issue-opened.yml workflow injection tied to a source commit; not a shipped Electron runtime version exposure.
